pages.title: The Service
pages.content:
The service

The Service

Kouhi Service installs and maintains countertop coffee equipment for workplaces across Northgate, Riverside, Old Mill, and Eastbank. Every monthly placement includes the machine, whole-bean coffee, scheduled care visits, and full repair coverage.

What a placement includes

Machine, beans and a monthly visit

Every month

Monthly visit

A technician cleans, descales and checks the machine, then agrees the next delivery with your office coordinator.

On your counter

The machine

A countertop bean-to-cup unit sized to your team, installed and calibrated for you. It stays ours, so you carry no depreciation.

Two house roasts and one rotating

The beans

Whole beans roasted in Northgate and delivered each month, with extra one-kilogram bags available whenever you need them.

In detail

What we do for you

The Countertop Machine

We place a dedicated countertop bean-to-cup machine suited to your team size, requiring only a standard electrical socket, cold water access, and forty by fifty centimetres of counter space. Our technicians handle complete installation, waterline connection or reservoir setup, and initial calibration to ensure every cup pours cleanly. Because the hardware remains our property throughout the agreement, your workplace never carries depreciation, capital expense, or maintenance headaches.

House Roasts and Monthly Delivery

Every subscription includes fresh whole beans roasted under the supervision of Mara Lindqvist at our Northgate workshop. Each month we deliver two reliable house roasts alongside one seasonal rotating origin, balanced for everyday office drinking with milk or black. We monitor your workplace consumption during regular checks, adjusting bean volume so your supply stays freshly roasted without cluttering pantry storage. Extra one-kilogram bags of house roast can be added at any time for twenty-eight dollars.

Routine Visits and Fast Repairs

Service lead Tomas Okafor and our technicians, Ines Duarte and Kenji Arnaud, conduct thorough monthly visits to inspect the group head, descale internal lines, check water filtration, and review settings with your office coordinator. If an operational fault or breakdown occurs between scheduled visits, we provide on-site repair or a complete machine swap within two working days. Travel, preventative descaling, replacement parts, and emergency callouts are always covered with no supplemental billing.

Want the full picture first? Read how the machines differ, or see the monthly price for your team size.

A tasting visit takes forty-five minutes, costs nothing and carries no obligation. Call +00 20 7946 0144 or email hello@kouhi.example.

Machines & Beans

We pair dependable bean-to-cup countertop hardware with freshly roasted whole beans formulated specifically for everyday workplace brewing. Equipment footprint, water capacity, and coffee roast profiles are balanced for consistent cup quality.

The hardware

Compact and Counter Hardware

We deploy two primary bean-to-cup machine models: the Compact and the Counter. Both require a flat surface of forty by fifty centimetres, access to cold water, and a standard domestic wall socket. The Compact model suits private studios, reception counters, and teams under thirty people, featuring an intuitive control panel and simplified daily rinse cycle. The Counter model accommodates busier workplace kitchens up to sixty staff, offering expanded bean hopper storage, higher thermal stability for back-to-back dispensing, and an easily removable drip tray for straightforward end-of-day maintenance.

pages.title: About Kouhi Service
pages.content:
About

About Kouhi Service

Founded in 2014, Kouhi Service was built to provide workplace coffee that equals the quality of independent specialty cafes without operational burdens for office managers. Our workshop and tasting room are located at 14 Harbour Row, Northgate.

Since 2014

Origins and Workshop Milestones

In 2014, founders Mara Lindqvist and Tomas Okafor noticed that while specialty coffee was thriving across the city, workplace kitchens remained burdened by pod waste, broken domestic brewers, or industrial vending machines. They established our workshop at 14 Harbour Row in Northgate, testing countertop hardware and roasting coffee specifically calibrated for bean-to-cup extraction. Over the past decade, we expanded our service footprint sequentially through Northgate, Riverside, Old Mill, and Eastbank, maintaining our strict commitment to personal monthly servicing and prompt technical dispatch.

Milestones

The team

The Seven-Person Team

Our entire operation is run by a dedicated seven-person team based at our Northgate facility. Mara Lindqvist manages green coffee sourcing and roasting quality, while co-founder Tomas Okafor directs technical operations and machine infrastructure. On the road, technicians Ines Duarte and Kenji Arnaud perform scheduled maintenance visits, water filtration checks, and on-site hardware repairs. At Harbour Row, Priya Nair coordinates tasting visits and technician schedules, Sam Whitfield oversees customer accounts and monthly subscription billing, and Lea Brandt manages day-to-day customer care and office support.

pages.title: Frequently Asked Questions
pages.content:
FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

Find clear answers regarding our office coffee placements, tasting sessions, equipment servicing, and billing structure. If your question is not covered here, our Northgate team is available Monday to Friday.

ServiceVisitsBillingMachines

Service

What happens during the monthly maintenance visit?

Our technician visits your office once a month to inspect the machine, clean the internal brew group, run full descaling cycles, test water temperature, adjust the grinder burrs, and deliver your fresh beans.

Which areas do you currently serve?

We provide regular service and deliveries to workplaces located throughout Northgate, Riverside, Old Mill, and Eastbank. Offices in adjacent districts can join our waitlist for upcoming route expansions.

What happens if a machine requires repair or stops working?

If your machine displays an error or fails to brew properly, simply notify Lea Brandt in customer care. Our technicians, Ines Duarte or Kenji Arnaud, will diagnose and resolve the issue on site, or provide a complete replacement unit within two working days. Preventative descaling, scheduled monthly servicing, all component replacements, and emergency callout labour are fully covered under your monthly subscription fee without any unexpected maintenance invoices.

Visits

How does the tasting visit work and what do we need to prepare?

Tasting visits take forty-five minutes and are completely free with no obligation to sign an agreement. We visit your office between 9:30 and 15:30 on Tuesdays, Wednesdays, or Thursdays. All you need to provide is forty by fifty centimetres of clear counter space, a domestic cold water tap, and an ordinary wall power socket. Our technician brews three coffees for your team to compare, checks counter access, and leaves a written proposal with exact monthly pricing.

How do we book a tasting visit?

Call +00 20 7946 0144 or email hello@kouhi.example. Priya Nair books visits Tuesday to Thursday between 9:30 and 15:30 and confirms the date by phone or email.

What space and power does the machine require?

The machine sits on any standard kitchen or breakroom counter, needing a clear surface of 40 by 50 centimetres and access to a standard electrical wall socket. It does not require dedicated plumbing.

Billing

What are the contract terms and billing notice periods?

All Kouhi Service plans carry an initial minimum term of three months, allowing your workplace to settle into the service and establish accurate consumption patterns. Following this initial period, billing transitions to a rolling monthly agreement managed by Sam Whitfield. You may adjust your plan tier or cancel service at any time by providing one month's written notice. There are no removal fees, machine return surcharges, or hidden administrative penalties.

Are there any setup fees or hidden costs?

Never. Delivery, initial counter setup, monthly maintenance visits, cleaning supplies, descaling, and scheduled bean deliveries are all fully covered under your agreed fixed monthly price.

Can we purchase additional beans if our office consumes more than our plan quota?

Yes. While our Desk, Studio, Office, and Clinic plans are calibrated to meet typical usage for their respective headcount tiers, teams can order extra whole beans whenever needed. Additional one-kilogram bags of our freshly roasted house coffee cost $28 each. You can request extra beans during your technician's monthly visit or contact our customer care desk, and we will deliver them directly to your counter.

Machines

Which machine will we get?

The Compact suits teams under thirty people and reception counters. The Counter suits busier kitchens up to sixty staff. We recommend one after your tasting visit.

What if the machine malfunctions or needs repair?

All maintenance, replacement components, and unexpected callouts are covered in your monthly plan. If an issue cannot be resolved on the spot, we repair or swap your machine within two working days.

Which beans do we receive?

Two house roasts and one rotating single origin each month, roasted in Northgate and delivered in unlabelled valved bags.

Book

Still have a question?

Call +00 20 7946 0144 on a weekday between 8:00 and 18:00, or email hello@kouhi.example.

Terms & Service Standards

This summary outlines the service commitments, technical repair standards, and contract terms governing every workplace coffee placement provided by Kouhi Service.

All service tiers, including Desk ($149/mo), Studio ($289/mo), Office ($489/mo), and Clinic ($259/mo), require an initial three-month minimum term starting from the installation date. Following three full billing cycles, subscriptions transition to a rolling monthly agreement managed by Sam Whitfield. Customers may adjust plan volume or cancel service entirely by submitting one month's written notice. Upon cancellation, our technicians will remove the machine at no additional charge.

Maintenance, Repairs, and Inclusions

Kouhi Service retains ownership and maintenance responsibility for all placed equipment. Scheduled monthly visits, descaling procedures, water filter replacements, and regular component wear are fully covered by your monthly subscription. In the event of a machine malfunction, our technicians will repair or replace the hardware within two working days. Clients will never be billed for visit travel, standard delivery, routine parts, or emergency replacement equipment, provided the hardware has been operated in accordance with standard guidelines.

This page explains what Kouhi Service keeps when you contact us, and why.

What we collect

When you book a tasting visit or join the waitlist we keep your name, work email, telephone number, office address and the number of people on your team. We collect nothing else about you through this website.

How we use it

Priya Nair uses these details to arrange visits and to tell you when a route opens in your area. Sam Whitfield uses billing details for monthly invoices once a plan starts. We do not sell or share them with other companies.

How long we keep it

Visit and waitlist details are deleted twelve months after your last contact unless you become a customer. Customer records are kept for as long as the law requires for accounts.

Your choices

Write to hello@kouhi.example to see, correct or delete what we hold. We reply within one working week. This website sets no advertising cookies.

posts.title: Why Regular Countertop Maintenance Changes Workplace Coffee
posts.excerpt: Routine mechanical care and fresh roast management prevent the slow decline in cup quality that affects most shared office machines.
posts.content:
In most workplaces, office coffee does not fail suddenly; it declines slowly through quiet neglect. A team purchases a domestic machine or signs an unmanaged lease, places it in the breakroom, and enjoys decent coffee for several weeks. Over subsequent months, mineral deposits accumulate in the boiler, residual coffee oils coat the group head, and bean hoppers are repeatedly topped up with stale beans from forgotten grocery bags. Because no single person in the office holds responsibility for descaling lines or checking extraction pressures, bitter and tepid coffee becomes accepted as the unavoidable standard of working life.

When Mara Lindqvist and Tomas Okafor founded Kouhi Service in 2014 at 14 Harbour Row in Northgate, they designed an operating model specifically to remove that maintenance burden from workplace managers. A commercial bean-to-cup machine requires consistent, skilled attention to perform properly. High-volume daily brewing pushes water through internal valves and heating blocks dozens of times every morning. Without routine inspection of internal gaskets and group assemblies, water temperature drops and extraction becomes uneven. Clean hardware is not an aesthetic preference; it is the fundamental mechanical condition required to extract sweetness, clarity, and aroma from roasted coffee.

This mechanical reality is why our service structure pairs every countertop machine with a scheduled monthly visit. Technicians Ines Duarte and Kenji Arnaud do not simply drop off fresh bags of coffee and depart. During their regular visits across Northgate, Riverside, Old Mill, and Eastbank, they strip and clean the dispensing group, check the calibration of the grinder, inspect water filtration cartridges, and run thorough descaling cycles. These forty-minute maintenance routines prevent the progressive wear that causes breakdowns, ensuring the machine in an architectural practice or accounting firm performs just as reliably in year three as it did during its initial installation week.

Hardware maintenance must also align directly with bean supply. Even perfectly calibrated machines cannot produce satisfying coffee from stale roasted beans that have sat in warm breakroom cupboards for months. We roast whole beans in small batches under Mara's supervision at our Harbour Row workshop, delivering two core house roasts and a rotating single origin on a predictable monthly cadence. By matching coffee quantities to whether an office uses our Desk plan for 12 people or an Office plan for 42 staff, pantry shelves remain orderly and hoppers are always supplied with beans at peak aroma. If consumption surges during intensive project cycles, extra one-kilogram bags are added for twenty-eight dollars without disrupting delivery schedules.

When hardware faults do arise, rapid accountability protects the working day. Office coordinators should never spend hours troubleshooting cryptic error codes or waiting weeks for third-party service contractors to arrive. Through customer care managed by Lea Brandt and technical dispatch led by Tomas Okafor, any machine failure is addressed on site or resolved with a complete replacement unit within two working days. By treating workplace coffee as a continuous managed service rather than an unmonitored appliance purchase, offices maintain cafe-quality cups every working morning without operational friction.
